name: open-knowledge
greeting:
OpenKnowledge — a markdown knowledge base for LLM wikis, specs and notes.

node and the `ok` CLI are installed. The knowledge base lives in
/workspace/notes; keep every note there.

To start it:
  1. In the webui, open this project's ⚙ → Ports, pick this box, add port
     8080 as a Web page (label it OpenKnowledge), and copy the address shown
     under it. The box restarts: click this tab to reconnect, then wait until
     `ok --version` answers (OpenKnowledge reinstalls, about a minute).
  2. cd /workspace/notes && ok init          (first time only)
  3. OK_ALLOW_EXTERNAL=1 ok start -p 8080 --no-open-browser \
        --idle-shutdown off --external-url <that address>
     then open the OpenKnowledge tab. It answers only at that exact address;
     the webui login is what guards the tab.
  4. In a second window (F2):  cd /workspace/notes && claude
     Log in first (/login): the box starts without credentials. Starting
     claude in notes/ is what gives it OpenKnowledge's tools.

Registering a port, or any other fresh restart of this box, stops
OpenKnowledge and logs the agent out; the notes are untouched. Wait until
`ok --version` answers, then repeat 3 and 4.
description: OpenKnowledge: a markdown knowledge base for wikis, specs and notes, kept in notes/ and edited in a webui tab beside the agent. Node and OpenKnowledge come installed; the terminal shows how to start it.
